# Clinical Trials

This folder contains foundational clinical trials that provide the scientific evidence base for the Danish Acute Surgery Database (Akut Kirurgi Databasen) and its national quality indicators. The studies documented here focus on mortality reduction in acute abdominal surgery and perforated peptic ulcers, directly informing clinical protocols for preoperative optimization, early antibiotic treatment, and rapid medical intervention.

## Pages

- [[aha-studiet|AHA-studiet]] — A mortality-reducing study on acute abdominal surgery that underpins national quality indicators for preoperative optimization, early antibiotics, and epidural analgesia.
- [[pulp-trial|PULP trial]] — A multi-center intervention trial investigating multimodal perioperative care for perforated peptic ulcers, providing the methodological foundation for the Acute Surgery Database and time-based surgical metrics.
